about: The pre-release compile matrix: the fewest legs that build each distinct firmware code path once. Run with `python scripts/compile-fixtures/compile-matrix.py --preset prerelease`. Each entry is `engine:family/sketch@tag` as `--list --every --engine all` prints it, with the one thing only that leg proves. Chosen from the 2026-11-26 firmware desk review.
